fact: Government Notice No. 148 of 18 August 2011 promulgates the Statistics Act, 2011 (Act No. 9 of 2011), signed by the President on 2 August 2011; this document is the text of the law.
The NSDI Policy gazetted on 6 March 2015 describes the Statistics Act, 2011 (No. 9 of 2011) as the law that establishes the NSDI and assigns the Statistician-General to administer it.

Under the Statistics Act, 2011 the Namibia Statistics Agency and the Ministry of Lands and Resettlement were charged to develop the NSDI Policy, issued as General Notice No. 103 and signed 24 February 2015.
The NSA data collection policy, signed March 2014, states it was developed in accordance with the Statistics Act, 2011 and to ensure compliance with it.
The Namibia Statistics Agency's National Statistics System document repository lists the Statistics Act 2011 among its documents.

The agency's strategic plan cites section 7(3)(b) of the Statistics Act as the basis on which it may pursue improved access to and use of spatial data and services; the plan gives no year for the Act, so this is dated to the plan's period start (April 2022).

The Namibia Statistics Agency's Data Portals page says the Statistics Act No. 9 of 2011 was passed by Parliament and signed by the President, providing for the national statistics system and establishing the Namibia Statistics Agency and its Board.

The Namibia Statistics Agency's census media release of 30 October 2024 says results are reported under the Statistics Act (Act 9 of 2011), which legally restricts publishing confidential information about individuals.
